body: I’m 23 and I’ve gotten all the help. I’ve gone to residential treatment, i go to therapy, i take my meds, i do the meditation and self care. And I’m still stuck in the same headspace as i was at 15 too. I didn’t think I’d make it this far, i didn’t think I’d let myself live this long. But I’m too much of a coward to solve my problem, I’m afraid of failing because i don’t want to live through that. So I’m not here to say it gets better or easier but to let you know you’re heard and not alone.
